proof_outline: A natural odd transitive subgroup fixing every outside letter cannot preserve a partition into pairs.
Each lobe is a five-sheet D5 action, sharing only the common root with other lobes.
An unexposed original two-color lobe retains its literal generated subgroup through internal Hurwitz moves.
Each elementary move conjugates only one tracked color and exposes at most one old lobe.
Two unexposed lobes rule out every leaf deletion being wreath; a single old unexposed lobe rules out a protected fresh-leaf wreath deletion.
Global sheet conjugation commutes with Hurwitz moves, so absolute relabelings do not change the lower bound.
